paragraphs.text: This Sabbath month, as it were, had as many feasts in it as were celebrated in all the year besides. So that as the Sabbath is the queen of days, so was this of months.

paragraphs.anchor: It is a day of blowing.

paragraphs.text: See Lev 23:34-35, &c., {See Trapp on "Lev 23:34"} &c There the feasts were prescribed, and here the sacrifices belonging to them are described.

In every of these seven days sacrifices, one bullock is abated: hereby the Holy Ghost might teach them their duty, to grow in grace and increase in sanctification, that their sins decreasing, the number of their sacrifices, whereby atonement was made for their sins, should also decrease daily. Or it might signify a diminishing and wearing away of the legal offerings, &c., as one well observeth; Hac caeremonia significabat Deus gratiam suam de die in diem crescere, ita nempe ut minuatur vetus homo, et novus augeatur, &c., saith Alsted, - till the very ruins of Satan’s castles be, as most of our old castles are, almost brought to ruin.
paragraphs.anchor: And on the second day ye shall offer twelve, &c.

paragraphs.text: That is, in manner and form aforesaid. The manner is that which makes or mars the action; as a good suit may be marred in the making, so a good duty: there may be malum opus in bona materia. Jehu’s zeal was rewarded as an act of justice, quoad substantiam operis; and punished as an act of policy, quoad modum agendi, for the perverse end. Yea, David, for failing in a ceremony only, though with an honest heart, suffered a breach instead of a blessing. {1Ch 15:13} Idolaters also went on in their own manner as their idol priests prescribed. "The manner of Beersheba liveth"; {Amo 8:14} that is, the form of rites of the worshipping in Beersheba, as the Chaldee paraphraseth.
